page.overview:
Who is Misty?

was a highborne clank bard played by Ashley Johnson in Age of Umbra. Unlike most clanks in the Halcyon Domain, empty or corrupted by the Umbra, she was animated by the soul of a dead girl, Sybil.

Misty looked like a beautiful but imposing stone statue, with humanoid features and four pairs of wings: a relic from the Old World, once a vessel for the spirits and angels of the Veiled Gods and made to worship them, but not empty, like the others upon the gods' departure. Standing eight feet tall, she was stained by years of lichen, dirt, and insect nests, and near the hem of her skirt there was some graffiti left by a child (herself, in fact, as Sybil). She wore a crown and the suggestion of a light veil had been carved into the stone over her face. The statue was originally meant to produce music, and thus it had many hollow sections, making Misty less strong than she looked; E1|8:48|Age of Umbra: Desperloch}} in fact, during a fight part of one of her wings broke, and she lost the top left one completely after a different battle on her way to Amber Reach.

When she magically disguised herself as a human, she looked like a woman in her twenties with wavy brown hair and eyes of the same color, and clothes inspired by the outfits of the rest of the group.

She was kind and curious, although very ignorant about some aspects of humanoid interaction.
